required_but_undefined: An executable warm-and-clean eligibility predicate for the MBO/MBP-10 comparator population.
An executable predicate defining when provider MBP-10 order counts and independently reconstructed active-order counts are semantically comparable.
Whether L1 means level-one size or an l1 depth norm, including the exact bid/ask/level aggregation.
The baseline comparator, paired observational unit, normalization, aggregation, and zero-denominator policy for relative size improvement.
The confidence level, sidedness, estimator, resampling unit, serial-dependence treatment, block length, random seed, and finite-sample rule for the required positive paired lower confidence bound.
The price-match numerator and denominator and whether the 0.1-percentage-point noninferiority margin applies to a point estimate or a confidence bound.
The treatment of unmatched, ambiguous, and flagged endpoints, including whether each class enters or is excluded from each denominator and how each class affects every pass-fail gate.
why_exact_parity_is_not_a_resolution: Primary/reference parity compares two implementations within one schema; it does not establish MBO-versus-MBP-10 equality.
Exact ten-level equality on a matched subset does not define the warm-clean or semantically-comparable population.
Exact equality cannot imply a strictly positive paired improvement lower bound. Against an exact baseline the improvement is zero; without a pinned baseline it is undefined.
DECISION-030 calls the quantitative gates secondary only in the sense that they cannot rescue an unexplained absolute mismatch; it does not make them optional.
DECISION-031 explicitly preserves the original comparable-count, anomaly, warm-clean, primary-reference, and residual-classification gates.
why_defaults_are_forbidden: Treating endpoint observations as iid without a pinned dependence assessment and dependence-aware uncertainty rule could produce anti-conservative uncertainty; neither the qualified endpoint population nor its dependence has been computed.
Choosing a bootstrap, block length, confidence level, denominator, or comparator after seeing the source would introduce researcher degrees of freedom.

A separately labelled forensic comparison with the legacy R0 bridge is not categorically forbidden, but the bridge was never pinned as the pass-fail baseline and cannot acquire that authority by analyst choice.

definition_search.result: Only the requirement prose in DECISION-030 and DECISION-031 matched; no executable definition, configuration, test, or accepted statistical specification was found.
definition_search.git_history_result: The terms enter hft-wiki history at commit 7a8098fff13b5c9687fc1cdac2d761ebef922ce7 without the missing definitions; no relevant implementation history was found in the named owner repositories.

independent_reviews.conclusion: No unique implementable interpretation is derivable, and exact parity cannot make the preserved gates vacuous.
No estimator or dependence-aware confidence procedure is pinned; choosing one now would create post-specification researcher degrees of freedom.

compute_boundary.reason: The contradiction is upstream of any truthful pass-fail market computation.

operator_or_accepted_decision_must_choos: Pin every missing population, estimand, comparator, denominator, uncertainty, dependence, seed, and threshold definition before restarting conformance.

Explicitly amend the accepted authority so the three underdefined quantitative measures are report-only diagnostics with no pass-fail authority, while still pinning warm-clean and comparable-count predicates.
required_resolution.forbidden_resolution: Do not infer defaults from observed 2025-07-03 data, a prior percentage, the legacy R0 path, or an iid endpoint bootstrap.

stopping_rule.effect: This further specification contradiction emits MBO_SEMANTICS_BLOCKER_V2.json and terminates the restarted MBO Cycle 1. MBO_SEMANTICS_CONFORMANCE_V1.json and every later F064 artifact are ineligible under the current authority.
